annotations.title: Search the results shelf for already-produced results

description: Searches the results shelf: results we already produced (datasets, transcripts, scored trials, research) sold with their full recipe, measured original cost and hashes. Matches every word of q against titles, summaries, tags and recipe fields; no q lists every item. Use it first to check whether a result has been produced already, before paying to produce it again. Use catalogue instead to list the models and jobs that produce new results. Use shelf_buy instead to buy an item you found. Free: searching, previews and item cards are never charged. Auth: none. Read-only; it has no error states of its own (no match = count 0).

q.description: Words to match (all must match, case-insensitive) in title, summary, tags and recipe fields; omit to list everything.

name: shelf_search

offers.description: output / recipe offers with on_sale, price_usd, files, bundle_sha256
